Identity.Name: Pset_StingHVACExecution
Identity.Definition: STING HVAC execution parameters — flow rates, load results, sizing outputs, pressure class, and acoustic targets for MEP coordination. Written by HvacBlockLoadCommand, MepAutoSizeDuctCommand, HvacNcPredictionCommand, HvacRefrigerantSizeCommand, and related calc engines.

Governance.StandardsBasis: ASHRAE 90.1; CIBSE Guide A; SMACNA HVAC Duct Construction Standards; BS EN 13779; VDI 2081; NFPA 99 §5.1

Property.name: HVC_PEAK_SENS_W
Property.Definition: Peak sensible cooling or heating load (W) from the block-load calculation. Written by HvacBlockLoadCommand.

Property.name: HVC_PEAK_LAT_W
Property.Definition: Peak latent cooling load (W) from the block-load calculation.

Property.name: HVC_PEAK_HOUR
Property.Definition: Hour of day (0–23) at which the design-day peak load occurs.

Property.name: HVC_OA_LS
Property.Definition: Outside air flow rate (L/s) required for this zone per ventilation calculation.

Property.name: HVC_FLOW_LS
Property.Definition: Supply or extract air flow rate (L/s) after sizing.

Property.name: HVC_DP_PA
Property.Definition: Pressure drop across this duct/pipe segment (Pa).

Property.name: HVC_VEL_MS
Property.Definition: Air or fluid velocity (m/s) in this segment after sizing.

Property.name: HVC_DN
Property.Definition: Nominal diameter or duct dimension after sizing (e.g. DN200 or 400x250).

Property.name: HVC_PRESSURE_CLASS_TXT
Property.Definition: SMACNA/HVCA duct pressure class: Low / Medium / High.

Property.name: HVC_LOAD_SOURCE_TXT
Property.Definition: Source of the load data: BlockLoad / Manual / Imported.

Property.name: HVC_LOAD_STALE_BOOL
Property.Definition: True when the stored load data is stale relative to the current geometry or schedules. Set by StingStaleMarker when geometry changes.

Property.name: HVC_PROD_REF_TXT
Property.Definition: Manufacturer product reference for the selected equipment item.

Property.name: HVC_SELECTED_IDU_ID_TXT
Property.Definition: Selected IDU catalogue identifier from STING_IDU_CATALOGUE.json.

Property.name: HVC_SELECTED_IDU_LABEL_TXT
Property.Definition: Human-readable display label for the selected IDU.

Property.name: HVC_IDU_MOUNTING_TXT
Property.Definition: IDU mounting type: Ceiling / Wall / Floor / Cassette / Concealed.

Property.name: HVC_SPACE_TYPE_TXT
Property.Definition: ASHRAE 90.1 / CIBSE Guide A space type classification used for load defaults.

Property.name: HVC_NC_PREDICTED
Property.Definition: Predicted NC curve value at the room listener position per VDI 2081 / ASHRAE A48 attenuation model.

Property.name: HVC_REFRIG_TYPE_TXT
Property.Definition: Refrigerant type for VRF/DX systems: R410A / R32 / R134a / CO2.

Property.name: HVC_REFRIG_PIPE_OD_MM
Property.Definition: Selected refrigerant pipe outside diameter (mm) from RefrigerantPipeSolver.

Property.name: HVC_SIZING_STRATEGY_TXT
Property.Definition: Duct sizing strategy applied: EqualFriction / StaticRegain / VelocityReduction / T-method.

Property.name: HVC_INSULATION_SPEC_TXT
Property.Definition: Insulation specification reference per BS 5422 / project spec clause.
